## Description

Applies Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) or Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT) to decompose price time-series into high and low frequency components, filtering noise before evaluating breakout signals.

## Where it may fit

Noisy price channels with high intraday variance where classical moving average breakouts generate false signals.

## Vehicles

Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), systematic futures/FX strategy funds.

## Required data

High-frequency minute/tick OHLCV data, wavelet mother wavelet choice (e.g., Daubechies 4).

## Caveats

Boundary effect look-ahead bias can occur if wavelets are calculated on future data windows; requires strictly causal sliding window filtering.
